title: [Bug]:  Fix a_run_swarm missing _link_agents_to_swarm_manager
body:
### Describe the bug

When running `a_run_swarm` with the following handoff:

```
register_hand_off(
        agent=router_agent,
        hand_to=[
            # Route to tech specialist when domain is technology
            OnContextCondition(
                target=tech_specialist,
                condition=ContextExpression(
                    "${current_domain} == 'technology_specialist'"
                ),
                available=ContextExpression("!${question_answered}"),
            ),
           ...
            # Default to user if no routing occurs
            AfterWork(AfterWorkOption.TERMINATE),
        ],
    )
```

The run fails with:

```
 File "/home/arunkarikalan/workativ/ag2_iterater_test/lib/python3.12/site-packages/autogen/agentchat/contrib/swarm_agent.py", line 335, in _run_oncontextconditions
    print("agent.name ::: ", agent._swarm_manager)
                             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
AttributeError: 'ConversableAgent' object has no attribute '_swarm_manager
```

This is due to a_run_swarm missing the `_link_agents_to_swarm_manager(groupchat.agents, manager)`call when setting up the swarm chat.

linked_prs.title: fix: register_handoff is not working as expected in a_run_swarm
linked_prs.body:
## Why are these changes needed?

I am doing one poc with a_run_swarm. I am just replicating the context router example using a_run_swarm. it didn't get transitioned properly. I got an error saying,

`AttributeError: 'ConversableAgent' object has no attribute '_swarm_manager'`

Closes #1603

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves agent workflow anomalies related to the `_link_agents_to_swarm_manager` function, which is essential for setting up the swarm chat. This directly pertains to the execution of the agent's workflow, making it an agent issue.
